sanskrit: yatsatyaṃ tu mayā kṛtaṃ mama vibho kṛtyaṃ tu nātaḥ paraṃ yanmanmānamaiśapādakamale bhaktyā mayaivārpitam | sarvasvamata evametaditarannāsyeva jānāmyatastyaktvā kṣipramanāthanātha karuṇāsindho prasanno bhava
l1:
## pan-p01 (1)
what-was-done-by-me-in-truth / indeed / by-me / done / my / O-Lord / duty / indeed / not / beyond-this / higher / which / my-pride / on-the-Lord's-lotus-feet / with-devotion / by-me / indeed / offered / my-all / therefore / indeed / this / other / not / exists / indeed / I-know / therefore / having-abandoned / quickly / O-protector-of-the-helpless / O-ocean-of-compassion / pleased / be // pan-p01
l2: Whatever I have truly done, O Lord — no duty of mine goes beyond this: my pride, laid at Your lotus feet with devotion. This is my all; I know there is nothing other. So, casting all else aside — quickly, O protector of the helpless, O ocean of compassion — be pleased with me!

sanskrit: maheśa tvaddvāri sphuratu rucirā vāgatitarāṃ mamaiṣā nirdoṣaṃ jaya jaya maheśeti satatam | śivā saiṣā vāṇī bhavatu śivadā mahyamaniśaṃ maheśanāthaṃ māṃ śaraṇada sanāthaṃ kuru vibho
l1:
## pan-p02 (2)
O-Maheśa / at-Your-door / let-flash-forth / charming / speech / exceedingly / my / this / faultless / victory / victory / O-Maheśa / thus / constantly / auspicious / that / this / speech / let-it-be / bliss-bestowing / for-me / unceasingly / having-Maheśa-as-protector / me / O-giver-of-refuge / possessed-of-a-protector / make / O-Lord // pan-p02
l2: O Maheśa, at Your door let this charming speech of mine flash forth, exceeding all: 'Victory, victory to Maheśa!' — faultless, unceasing. Let this very speech, auspicious, be bliss-giving to me forever. O Lord, O giver of refuge, make me — whose protector is Maheśa — possessed of a protector!

sanskrit: brūṣe nottamāṅga paśyasi na māmetādṛśaṃ duḥkhitaṃ vijñaptiṃ bahudhā kṛtāṃ na śṛṇuṣe nāyāsi manmānase | saṃsārārṇavagartamadhyapatitaṃ prāyeṇa nālambase vākcakṣuḥśravaṇāṅghriṇādirahitaṃ tvāmāha satyaṃ śrutiḥ
l1:
## pan-p03 (3)
You-speak / not / O-best-limbed-one / You-see / not / me / such / suffering / entreaty / in-many-ways / made / not / You-listen / not / You-come / into-my-mind / fallen-into-the-pit-amid-the-ocean-of-transmigration / mostly / not / You-support / devoid-of-speech-sight-hearing-feet-and-the-like / You / declares / truly / scripture // pan-p03
l2: You speak not, O best-limbed one; You look not upon me, wretched as I am. My entreaty, made in many ways, You hear not; You come not into my mind. Fallen into the pit amid transmigration's ocean, I am mostly left unsupported — yet scripture truly declares You devoid of speech, sight, hearing, feet and the like!

sanskrit: gurorvākyādyukti-pracaya-racana-unmārjana-vaśātsamāśvāsācchāstraṃ prati samucitādapi kathitam | vilīne śaṅkābhre hṛdayagaganodbhāsimahasaḥ prabhoḥ sūryasyeva spṛśatu caraṇān dhvāntajayinaḥ
l1:
## pan-p04 (4)
of-the-guru / from-the-word / by-force-of-wiping-away-the-fabric-of-piled-up-reasonings / from-assurance / scripture / regarding / from-what-is-fitting / even / told / when-dissolved / the-cloud-of-doubt / whose-splendor-shines-in-the-heart-sky / of-the-Lord / of-the-sun / like / let-touch / the-feet / of-the-darkness-conquering-one // pan-p04
l2: From the guru's word — by the force that wipes away the fabric of heaped-up reasonings — and from the assurance told, fittingly, out of regard for scripture: when the cloud of doubt has dissolved, let me touch the feet of the Lord, whose splendor shines in the sky of the heart — like the sun, the conqueror of darkness.

sanskrit: yātastvatsahavāsato bahutaraḥ kālo vatāsmin kṣaṇe kiṃ kiṃ vā na kṛtaṃ tvayā varagurūpāsānimittena me | vāraṃ vāramahaṃ punarnirupamāṃ divyaṃ bhuvaṃ prāsuvatkāyastvāṃ kila vismarāmi yadataḥ stheyaṃ na bhūyastvayā
l1:
## pan-p05 (5)
gone / from-dwelling-with-You / very-long / time / alas / in-this / moment / what / what / or / not / done / by-You / for-the-sake-of-serving-the-excellent-guru / for-me / time / after-time / I / again / incomparable / divine / plane / whose-body-has-attained-it / You / indeed / I-forget / since / therefore / to-be-remained / not / further / by-You // pan-p05
l2: Much time dwelling with You has passed — alas, in this very moment! What, what has not been done by You for me, for the sake of serving the excellent guru! Again and again I, whose body has attained the incomparable divine plane — yet indeed I forget You. Therefore, by You, let there be no further staying-away!
